name: Ocean of EPUB
description: Ocean of EPUB — light novel, manga and web novel index. Index and cover browsing only: verified 2026-10-05, its file links are dead and the app has no HTML source runtime yet, so it is published as not-readable rather than as a working source.
readableNote: Not yet usable in-app, and deliberately not marked readable. Two independent blockers were verified against the live site on 2026-10-05. (1) NO FILE: three detail pages were fetched and none exposed a retrievable file. Permalinks are /epubpdf-{title}-{category}/ WordPress posts; covers resolve from the Jetpack CDN (i0.wp.com). Where a book lists a download it is a charexempire.com shortlink, which 302s to kecapku.com/safe.php and then bounces to Google's redirect for that parked domain - a 0-byte HTML page, not a file. One sampled book had no download link at all. (2) NO RUNTIME: the selectors below are correct for this site (verified with cheerio: 'article.post' matches 6 results on a search page and yields title, url and cover) but the app's only HTML client is Madara-specific and hard-codes 'div.page-item-detail.manga', which matches 0 elements here. So installing this today returns nothing. The endpoint block is kept as the exact contract a generic HTML client would need: add a client branch honouring the list/title/url_/thumb selectors, then flip readable to true. The 'type: html' markers are a proposal, not a supported convention.
